items.title: Hugo Gonzalez needs to stop anticipating screens. If they come, just play through them. He goes looking for the contact, and takes himself out of the play when the screen isn't even there.
items.author: KeithSmithNBA
items.body_excerpt:
Hugo Gonzalez needs to stop anticipating screens. If they come, just play through them. He goes looking for the contact, and takes himself out of the play when the screen isn't even there.

All part of the learning process. He'll get there.

The Boston Celtics have picked up the 2027-28 rookie scale team options for Hugo Gonzalez and Baylor Scheierman, a league source told @spotrac.com.

This is the third-year option for Gonzalez and the fourth-year option for Scheierman.
